entities.summary: Soyuz MS-28, identified by NASA as Soyuz 74S, is a Russian crewed Soyuz spaceflight launched from Site 31/6 at the Baikonur Cosmodrome on 27 November 2025 to the International Space Station, where it docked to Russia's Rassvet docking port.
